Kliko Truck Platform is a modular 3D-printable RC truck chassis built for makers who want a functional cargo hauler, not a shelf-only model. Its 1:20 scale balances usable electronics space with parts that remain practical to print at home. Build it in 6x4 or 4x2 form, add working lights, cargo bodies, and control hardware, then keep growing it through the broader CyberBrick ecosystem.
Real Hauling Play

context.title: Modular Truck Platform - CyberBrick RC
context.near: Cargo bodies mount directly to the chassis, so your build becomes a working hauler instead of a static display piece. Printable accessories let you stage loads,

strings.en: Cargo bodies mount directly to the chassis, so your build becomes a working hauler instead of a static display piece. Printable accessories let you stage loads, create routes, and keep expanding the truck after the base build is finished.
Customizable lighting

context.title: Modular Truck Platform - CyberBrick RC
context.near: The CyberBrick app allows for customizing LED lights, enhancing realism and visual appeal during operation. Integrated lighting support adds practical feedback.

strings.en: The CyberBrick app allows for customizing LED lights, enhancing realism and visual appeal during operation. Integrated lighting support adds practical feedback. It also gives the truck a more complete RC feel without relying on fragile cosmetic add-ons.

context.near: A servo-operated coupling turns trailer handling into part of the drive, not a manual reset between runs. Hook up, drop off, and switch tasks from the controlle

strings.en: A servo-operated coupling turns trailer handling into part of the drive, not a manual reset between runs. Hook up, drop off, and switch tasks from the controller for more realistic yard work.
Drive It Your Way

strings.en: CyberBrick remote compatibility keeps steering, throttle, and functions in one familiar control setup. Builders can focus on tuning the truck and adding modules instead of inventing a control system from scratch.

CyberBrick 4WD Car turns a 3D print into a fast, hands-on RC build with real mechanical depth. Its double wishbone independent suspension and 4WD platform give makers a more capable drive than a simple display model. A combination lighting system adds separate headlight and indicator functions for a richer driving feel. Support from the Cyberbrick ecosystem make it an ideal choice for experienced model enthusiasts seeking personalized customization.
4h to assemble
